systems.name: Arena
systems.tldr: Players can now exit the game safely prior to their final Combat Phase ending and their placement being determined. Previously, exiting the game before all other teams' combat had ended would soft-lock the player with…
systems.gameplayImpact: Arena was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players can now exit the game safely prior to their final Combat Phase ending and their placement being determined. Previously, exiting the game before all other teams' combat had ended would soft-lock the player within the Reconnect screen and force them to wait for the entire game to finish or restart the Client.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: In the case of exiting prior to the placement being determined, the team's placement is now only visible to players within the game's match history entry.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: [Note: This does not affect the presentation in the match history, as an Arena game's entry is still only added there upon the entire game finishing.]

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Damage to the Target Dummy in Arena is now special-cased to not disable the shop's Undo function for the remainder of the Shop Phase.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: All teams' Target Dummy will now invariably spawn at 5 seconds into the Shop Phase.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: The game no longer requests (via a text pop-up on their model) that both teammates in a team spend all their gold in order for their Target Dummy to spawn.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Issuing a Select order (default: MB1 / left-click) on a player from another team is now also valid for changing the scoreboard's view to their team.

systems.name: General
systems.tldr: Players can now exit the game safely prior to their final Combat Phase ending and their placement being determined. Previously, exiting the game before all other teams' combat had ended would soft-lock the player with…
systems.gameplayImpact: General was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players can now exit the game safely prior to their final Combat Phase ending and their placement being determined. Previously, exiting the game before all other teams' combat had ended would soft-lock the player within the Reconnect screen and force them to wait for the entire game to finish or restart the Client.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: In the case of exiting prior to the placement being determined, the team's placement is now only visible to players within the game's match history entry.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: [Note: This does not affect the presentation in the match history, as an Arena game's entry is still only added there upon the entire game finishing.]

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Damage to the Target Dummy in Arena is now special-cased to not disable the shop's Undo function for the remainder of the Shop Phase.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: All teams' Target Dummy will now invariably spawn at 5 seconds into the Shop Phase.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: The game no longer requests (via a text pop-up on their model) that both teammates in a team spend all their gold in order for their Target Dummy to spawn.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Issuing a Select order (default: MB1 / left-click) on a player from another team is now also valid for changing the scoreboard's view to their team.

systems.gameplayImpact: Mode was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.
